provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Android: Netrunner core rules (Fantasy Flight Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Decide who is the Runner and who the Corporation; identity card faceup, take the matching deck
steps.note: First game: Shaper and Jinteki starter decks (a faction's cards plus that side's neutral cards)

steps.text: Token bank: credits, advancement, brain damage, tag, bad publicity and generic tokens
Shuffle your deck and offer it to your opponent to shuffle
Draw {n} cards each; the Corporation decides on a mulligan first, then the Runner
steps.note: A mulligan hand must be kept

steps.text: The Corporation always takes the first turn
